about.text: Trappista or Trapist is a traditional Bosnian semi-hard cow's-milk cheese made by Trappists branch of Cistercians order of Mariastern abbey in Banja Luka, Bosnia and Herzegovina.

sources.text: Port-Salut style; article gives no ripening time; mass-produced Hungarian versions are foil-ripened and differ
